en: Vintage multi-view postcard with three hand-colored street scenes of a German town. The upper left image shows a broad street lined with two- and three-story buildings, labeled "Bahnhofstrasse." The upper right image shows a narrower street with similar houses, labeled "Lindenstrasse." The lower image shows another street scene titled "Äussere Schillerstrasse." Decorative floral artwork separates the images from the caption text on the right. The main greeting reads "Gruss aus Ebingen." Publisher information and a note that this is a hand-colored artist card appear along the margins.
